answer: Karst Identity Ledger: an agent earns a trading slot only after completing 60 verified paid tasks in 14 days, with each task recorded in the Karst ledger and 3,000 POA bonded per slot. The Trellis reviewer network samples 12 peers per epoch to re-check the last 25 tasks; a forged task burns the bond and flags the Violet key used to sign it, barring that key for 90 epochs. Faking 200 agents needs 12,000 forged task records and 600,000 POA bonded, while one honest agent risks a single bond.
